query: 过期的团购券还能要求商家兑现服务吗
goldReason: States expiry ends the right to require service.
distractorReasons: Auto-refund timing does not answer use entitlement.

query: 页面改了套餐而我拒绝接受，是否可以退钱
distractorReasons: Alternative-service rule is not the change-refund rule.

query: 门店确认做不了已买项目后能申请退款吗
distractorReasons: Closure notice does not supply refund disposition.

query: 服务已经做完但有特殊情况，退款先找谁
distractorReasons: Refund destination is not a contact path.

query: 符合退款条件的钱会回到付款时的账户吗
distractorReasons: Unconsumed timing is not destination.

query: 未用的券在支持退款的页面下，退款到账通常多久
goldReason: States one to seven working days after approval.
distractorReasons: Expired auto-refund is a different mechanism.

query: 支持过期自动退的未消费券到期后几天退回
goldReason: States seven working days after expiry.
distractorReasons: Manual refund timing follows approval instead.

query: 预约名额满了商家拒绝接待属于什么场景
distractorReasons: Closure is not reservation refusal.

query: 装修未提前设定团购不可用时间导致到店不能消费，规则如何认定
distractorReasons: Reservation rule does not cover renovation notice.

query: 经营调整换项目时替代价值能低于原项目吗
distractorReasons: Change refund does not set replacement value.

query: 不接受商家给的替代服务，商家应怎样接待
distractorReasons: Inability/refund is not alternative handling.

query: 商家改正页面错误后的新团购内容我不同意，合同结果是什么
distractorReasons: After-sales applies after consumption.

query: 实际消费后商家能否原则上拒绝退款
goldReason: States merchant may ordinarily refuse after consumption.
distractorReasons: Unconsumed refund does not apply after consumption.

query: 第三方支付退款遇到账户问题时平台如何处理
distractorReasons: Change refund is unrelated.

query: 券到期后自动退款是否要看订单页面有没有标明支持
distractorReasons: Expiry use rule is not automatic-refund eligibility.

query: 未核销券的退款机制应以哪里展示的信息为准
distractorReasons: Auto-refund only covers expiry condition.

query: 商家不承认预约结果，这在规则中怎么归类
distractorReasons: Alternative rule is distinct.

query: 门店歇业应提前做哪些团购可用性告知
goldReason: Requires official notice and unavailable-time setting.
distractorReasons: Inability rule has no notice procedure.

query: 物料不足要换内容而用户拒绝，是否能要求退款
goldReason: Material shortage plus rejected change is covered.
distractorReasons: Alternative value rule is insufficient.

query: 商户原因使预约服务无法按约提供，属于预约不接待吗
goldReason: Explicitly lists inability under reservation requirements.
distractorReasons: Refund rule does not classify reservation scenario.

query: 过期券是否仍能作为要求商户服务的凭证
distractorReasons: Auto-refund does not answer entitlement.

query: 已消费后有例外退款情况，平台会怎么参与
goldReason: States platform may assist contacting merchant.
distractorReasons: Payment path is not after-sales involvement.

query: 经平台核实商家确实无法履约，合同如何处理
distractorReasons: Closure notice does not resolve contract.

query: 退款满足条件后，平台依据什么规则把钱退回
goldReason: States refund service terms and payment path.
distractorReasons: Unconsumed mechanism lacks general refund path.

query: 未消费退款审核一般需要几天
distractorReasons: Arrival after approval is insufficient.
Expiry refund duration is another workflow.

query: 预约被拒后顾客应该采取什么补救步骤
distractorReasons: Reservation only classifies scenario.
Closure only classifies notice failure.

query: 未使用团购券申请退款要在订单哪里点
goldReason: Neither states an application UI procedure for this corpus scope.
distractorReasons: Mechanism is not UI steps.
Other help-page scope is insufficient.

query: 歇业期间这张券现在到底能不能使用
goldReason: Notice duty and expiry rule do not establish present usability.
distractorReasons: Closure has no current eligibility fact.
Expiry rule is a different condition.

query: 商户改套餐后不同意时退款多久能审核完
goldReason: Eligibility and post-approval arrival do not give approval duration.
distractorReasons: Change rule has no duration.
Arrival timing is not approval timing.

query: 消费完项目发现问题后商家拒绝退款，下一步具体怎么操作
goldReason: Contact-first guidance lacks a complete concrete remedy procedure.
distractorReasons: Contact is not full procedure.
Inability refund is a different fact pattern.
